news.headline: NeurAxis discloses executive RSU grants and completed stock option exchange in 8-K
news.summary: The company detailed that its previously approved stock option exchange became effective July 24, 2026 (1,319,394 options swapped 1-for-1 into instantly-vesting RSUs, including ~199K each to CEO Brian Carrico and CMO Adrian Miranda), plus new Aug. 13 RSU grants to the CEO, CFO Timothy Henrichs, CMO and CRO vesting over three years, and one-time equity awards totaling 127,120 shares to independent directors.

news.headline: NeurAxis reports record Q2 2026 results with 116% revenue growth, but stock falls on EPS miss
news.summary: Q2 revenue rose 116% YoY to $1.9M (eighth straight quarter of double-digit growth) on Category I CPT-code-driven payer coverage, gross margin expanded 230bps, and cash used in operations improved to $1.0M with $8.3M cash on hand; shares still fell over 6% as the $0.19 per-share loss missed the $0.16 consensus estimate.

news.headline: NeurAxis expands payer coverage with new Mid-Atlantic medical policies
news.summary: New medical policy coverage decisions for PENFS/IB-Stim were added representing over 500,000 covered lives, expanding patient access to the therapy for beneficiaries in the Mid-Atlantic region.

news.headline: NeurAxis schedules Q2 2026 results and business update call for August 11
news.summary: The company announced it would release summarized Q2 2026 financial results before market open on August 11, 2026, with a conference call and webcast the same morning at 9:00am ET.

news.headline: NeurAxis stock option exchange becomes effective, converting 1.3M options to RSUs
news.summary: The previously stockholder-approved exchange program went effective, cancelling 1,319,394 outstanding stock options and reissuing an equivalent number of RSUs 1-for-1 under the 2022 Omnibus Plan, with top executives' awards vesting immediately.

news.headline: NeurAxis declares Q2 2026 stock dividend on Series B Preferred Stock
news.summary: The board authorized a second-quarter stock (not cash) dividend on Series B Preferred Stock, issuing roughly 80,463 common shares to preserve cash, payable July 29 to holders of record July 21.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings and business update call
catalysts.detail: Based on the Q1 (May 12) and Q2 (Aug 11) reporting cadence, Q3 2026 results are expected in mid-November 2026; will show whether the post-Category-I-CPT-code revenue acceleration and payer-coverage expansion are continuing.

catalysts.label: Additional payer/medical-policy coverage wins for PENFS
catalysts.detail: Following the Dec. 2025 ~45M-covered-lives milestone, April 2026's four-insurer ~1.25M-lives expansion, and August 2026's 500,000-lives Mid-Atlantic win, further regional payer coverage announcements are a recurring near-term catalyst as more insurers adopt the new Category I CPT code.

catalysts.label: Continued Category I CPT code monetization / full-reimbursement device sales ramp
catalysts.detail: The CPT code took effect Jan. 1, 2026; management has flagged accelerating device sales at full reimbursement rates as coverage expands, which should keep supporting revenue growth and gross margin expansion in coming quarters.

catalysts.label: Additional clinical trials of PENFS in new pediatric and adult indications
catalysts.detail: Company commentary references ongoing/planned clinical studies of PENFS in further pediatric and adult conditions with large unmet need, which could support future label/indication expansion beyond the current FAP/IBS/functional dyspepsia clearance.

catalysts.label: Potential additional capital raise
catalysts.detail: NeurAxis has a history of registered direct offerings and warrant exercises (e.g., a May 2025 $5M raise) and an active S-3 shelf; continued cash burn from operations makes further dilutive financing a watchable event.

pulse: NeurAxis enters late August 2026 riding the tailwind of its new Category I CPT code, with Q2 2026 revenue up 116% YoY to $1.9M and payer coverage now reaching well over 500,000 additional lives from Mid-Atlantic policies announced August 4 -- its eighth straight quarter of double-digit growth. However, the stock sold off after Q2 earnings on a wider-than-expected per-share loss, and the past month brought heavy insider equity activity (a stock option exchange and fresh executive/director RSU grants disclosed August 13-19) that some investors may read as dilutive even as it aligns management incentives. Near-term watch items are further payer coverage wins, continued gross margin expansion from full-reimbursement device sales, and the Q3 2026 earnings call expected around mid-November.
